content: FastAPI's TestClient (httpx-based) maintains a persistent cookie jar across requests made on the same TestClient instance -- a Set-Cookie from a /login response is automatically resent on subsequent requests from that client, enabling end-to-end session-cookie auth tests. Caveat: cookies marked Secure are only resent by httpx when the request URL scheme is https; TestClient's default base_url is http://testserver, so a hardcoded secure=True cookie will not round-trip in tests unless the test client's base_url is overridden to https:// or the app derives 'secure' from the live request scheme rather than a hardcoded flag.
